text_block_list.text:
Our "first three years" with T.M. Opera O 
were a massive success. It became the 
glorious tale of the birth of the 
"Century's End Overlord."

The dawn of TM Opera O has arrived. And 
what unfolds next is—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahahaha! Absolute and unyielding! The 
reign of my autocratic monarchy begins 
now—!!!!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, I have won yet again... The royal 
vault is already overflowing with GⅠ 
trophies.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hauu~, 2nd place again... I really wanted 
to win at least one race, though~...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Once again, TM Opera O finishes first! 
Meisho Doto takes second!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
No one can break this one-two finish. No 
one...! This is an absolute dynasty!

text_block_list.name: Top Contender Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
It's over... It's all over... No one can 
ever claim the glory of a GⅠ crown 
again...

text_block_list.name: Top Contender Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
It's the Dark Ages...! We're all gonna 
die, everyoneee!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: No, I'm not gonna die. Seriously...

And so, the smiles faded from the 
Umamusume of Tracen Academy...

The existence of the "End-of-Century 
Overlord" becomes a dark cloud... crushing 
all dreams underfoot...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Fufu, fufufu... Fufufufufu...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! Beautiful! Truly beautiful, 
Trainer! Doto!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
This is the perfect domination that I 
dreamed of!
choice_data_list: Did I... go a bit too far?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
That might be true. Everyone was 
shivering, so it was a little~

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, what are you talking about? You 
truly see nothing at all, do you?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Look, behold! That glorious sight!

Suddenly, the dark clouds parted, and 
sunlight streaming through the gap 
illuminated the training grounds. And 
there...

text_block_list.name: Hot-Blooded Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O... Once I debut, I'm going to 
defeat her! Without fail...!

text_block_list.name: Cool Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Heh, easier said than done. No matter how 
many strategies I devise, I can't find a 
single breakthrough...

text_block_list.name: Cool Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Both you and I got turned right back 
around.

text_block_list.name: Hot-Blooded Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Then... wanna train together? If the two 
of us team up, we're bound to find 
something!

text_block_list.name: Cool Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Teaming up with you—I'd rather die. ...is 
what I thought, but it can't be helped. 
Let's do this!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Light exists because there are shadows. 
Hope is born from within despair. And 
then—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Because there is an absolute "Overlord of 
the End of the Century," everyone joins 
forces and competes together to defeat 
him!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Beneath the soil of the kingdom of terror, 
new buds are already beginning to sprout.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It is precisely under tyranny that an even 
stronger bud begins to sprout.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
This is precisely what I dreamed of! The 
absolute kingdom of the "Overlord of the 
End of the Century," and the new heroes 
rising to challenge it.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It is precisely within that endless cycle 
of struggle that my eternal kingdom shall 
be perfected!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, this is an innovation in the name 
of domination! Bwahahaha!

"Now, T.M. Opera O's true plan is finally 
revealed. But..."

"I have a feeling that was made up on the 
spot just now. ...Well, let's not dwell on 
it."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hawawa, as expected of Opera O-san. So one 
day, the ultimate hero will be born...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, the chosen one shall arrive at my 
demonic castle. And thus, the final battle 
begins...!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Crushing that hero by mere millimeters! 
Beating them to a pulp, shattering their 
very spirit!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha, o hero. You must start over 
from the beginning. Return to square one!

...Though, unlike an evil demon king, she 
has no intention whatsoever of losing.

TM Opera O narrows her eyes and looks out 
at the mortal realm below from the 
rooftop.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, how exquisite... My absolute 
sovereign reign."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The verdant turf across which I sprint. 
The grand zelkova tree casting its 
refreshing shade. Such nature is truly 
beautiful...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Those who serve me. And Trainer-kun 
standing by my side. What a beautiful 
bond...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And to those who challenge me: the budding 
sprouts that rise to crush oppression are 
truly beautiful...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"And above all! Infinitely, 
overwhelmingly, absolutely more than 
that—"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Shining at the very center is none other 
than I, the "Overlord of the End of the 
Century"! TM Opera O is the epitome of 
beauty!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahahahaha!!!!!!

As everyone's Supreme Overlord, everyone's 
goal, and everyone's terror, TM Opera O 
reigns with resplendent majesty.

The story of this era of sole supremacy 
will surely be passed down in Umamusume 
history as the greatest of operas.
